versions.changelog: Ask before delegating, changing configuration or overwriting files.

Initial release of oceantoken-models skill.

- Enables choosing, comparing, and pricing AI models via OceanToken.
- Supports model search by type, publisher, capabilities, and pricing.
- Provides cost estimation with confidence indicators before running tasks.
- Allows delegation of sub-tasks to alternative models for bulk or specialized work.
- Includes guidance for balance management and handling low-credit scenarios.
- Designed for both English and Chinese-language requests.
